test_GemmaTokenizer_integration: test the GemmaTokenizer class with integration expected tokens and token IDs for round-trip encoding/decoding
test_GemmaTokenizer_encode_decode: test the GemmaTokenizer encode and decode methods produce expected token lists and decoded text
test_GemmaTokenizer_special_tokens: test the GemmaTokenizer handles special tokens like bos, eos, unk, pad, and mask correctly
test_GemmaTokenizer_padding_truncation: test the GemmaTokenizer padding and truncation behavior with input_ids and attention_mask model input names
test_GemmaTokenizer_multi_language: test the GemmaTokenizer correctly tokenizes multi-language text including emoji, Chinese, and Thai characters
